skills.notes: A Using Preparing Herbs manoeuvre must be made whenever attempting to use a magical herb. Success indicates that the herb has full effect. Lower results indicate the herb has lesser or no effect. Absolute Failure might indicate an allergic reaction, or worse.

skills.name: Using/Removing Poison
skills.description: This skill provides a bonus for handling, caring and storing of poisons. Allows individual to use poison without accidentally poisoning himself or rendering the poison useless.
skills.difficulties-summary: <li>Easy: Using a powder. <li>Light: Poisoning food or drink with a liquid. <li>Medium: Poisoning food or drink with a paste. <li>Hard: Poisoning a weapon with a paste. <li>Very Hard: Poisoning a weapon with a liquid.
skills.notes: A Using/Removing Poison manoeuvre must be made whenever attempting to use a poison. Success indicates that the poison has full effect. Lower re-suits indicate the poison has lesser or no effect. If the manoeuvre fails, the character must himself make a RR vs. the poison. This skill must also be used to successfully remove poison from a weapon. (Poisons cannot be removed from food.)

skills.name: Ventriloquism
skills.description: This skill provides a bonus for speaking without appearing to do so. A successful manoeuvre will make the individual's voice seem to originate somewhere other than himself, to a distance of up to 1'/level.
skills.difficulties-summary: <li>Easy: Normal conversation. <li>Medium: Whisper. <li>Very Hard: Loud conversation. <li>Sheer Folly: Scream or other loud noise.
skills.notes: The difficulty of a Ventriloquism manoeuvre depends on the volume of the noises being thrown. This skill is often used with Mimicry in order to carry on a two-way conversation with oneself. Modifiers: [Language utilizes excessive labial sounds:-20] [With props:+15] [Distance voice is thrown:-5 for every 1' away]

skills.name: Vital Points Lore
skills.description: This skill provides a bonus for recognizing the vital points of attack on a foe. This knowledge is very specialized and is often guarded jealously. The study of vital points is very complex and takes into account the time of day, season, and emotional state of the target in some of the more advanced and esoteric techniques. This skill must be taken for each general type of foe (I.e., humanoid, reptile, etc) A successful vital points lore static manoeuvre against an opponent can allow the practitioner to modify his next critical roll by 2 point during melee combat in the current of following round. This skill requires a 25% activity action in the round that it is attempted.
skills.difficulties-summary: No difficulties-summary provided
skills.notes: No notes

skills.name: Warding Lore
skills.description: This skill provides a bonus for manipulating and us-ing wards in conjunction with the appropriate ward spells It also allows a spell user to pursue non-magical research in defining and identifying new wards to add to his repertoire of ward spells.
skills.difficulties-summary: <li>Routine: Recognizing a ward as magical. <li>Easy: Identifying the approximate power of a ward. <li>Light: Identifying the realm of a ward. <li>Medium: Learning a very low level (1-5) ward. <li>Hard: Learning a low level (6-10) ward. Identifying a ward's trigger. <li>Very Hard: Learning a medium level (11-15) ward. <li>Extremely Hard: Learning a high level (16-20) ward. <li>Sheer Folly: Learning a very high level (21-50) ward. <li>Absurd: Learning an extremely high level (51+) ward.
skills.notes: Warding Lore is used to identify the spell imbedded in a ward by an-other caster. The GM might also a!low this skill to be used to design new wards. Reduce the difficulty level by one if the caster is attempting to identify the spell, not learn it. Note that a caster can memod forrize one warevery rank of Ward-ing Lore, plus his Memory bonus.

skills.name: Weapon Style (Advanced)
skills.description: This skill allows the wielder to become more skilled in combat with his chosen weapon. The Advanced Weapon Style skill incorporates the most difficult combat techniques.
skills.difficulties-summary: No difficulties-summary provided
skills.notes: The Advanced Weapon Style skill bonus represents the offensive bonus of the character while using his weapon in the manner prescribed by the weapon style. Each weapon style must be developed separately. Refer to Section 8.0 for more on weapon styles

skills.name: Weapon Style (Basic)
skills.description: This skill allows the wielder to become more proficient at fighting with his chosen weapon. The Basic Weapon Style skill incorporates very effective combat techniques.
skills.difficulties-summary: No difficulties-summary provided
skills.notes: The Basic Weapon Style skill bonus represents the offensive bonus of the charac- Part II Section 7.2 Combat Maneuvers ter while using his weapon in the manner prescribed by the weapon style. Each weapon style must be developed separately. Refer to Section 8.0 for more on weapon styles.

skills.name: Weapon Style Lore
skills.description: This skill provides a bonus for recognizing a particular weapon style. This skill allows the user to anticipate the most common subcategories of attacks of a weapon style as well as recognize the respected masters of weapon styles. Successful lore static manoeuvres may allow the user to anticipate attacks of a person using a weapon style. A successful weapon style lore static manoeuvres will give a special +2 bonus to the initiative roll for the duration of the combat, provided the opponent continue to use the same weapon style. This skill requires 25% activity action in the round that it is attempted.
skills.difficulties-summary: No difficulties-summary provided
skills.notes: This skill requires 25% activity action in the round that it is attempted. Obscure, secret or forgotten weapon styles will impose a negative modifier on the use of this skill

skills.name: Weather Watching
skills.description: This skill provides a bonus for determining local weather for the next 24 hours.
skills.difficulties-summary: <li>Routine: 1 hour <li>Easy: 6 hours <li>Light: 1 day <li>Medium: 2 days <li>Hard: 3 days <li>Very Hard: 4 days <li>Extremely Hard: 5 days <li>Sheer Folly: 6 days <li>Absurd: 1 week
skills.notes: The difficulty of Weather Watching depends on how far into the future the character wants to forecast. Note that even if the manoeuvre is successful, the character will often not get specific information. The GM may decide to inform the player of the percentage chance of rain when making long-term predictions, rather than when it will rain.

skills.name: Weaving
skills.description: This provides a bonus to static manoeuvres involving weaving. These skills include fashioning garments, blankets, etc. as well as repairing such items.
skills.difficulties-summary: <li>Routine: Weaving plain rough cloth (e.g., Sacking). <li>Easy: Weaving plain simple cloths using the same thick thread (e.g., Blanket). <li>Light: Weaving simple patterned cloths using the same thick thread. (e.g., Plaid blanket) <li>Medium: Weaving plain cloths using medium threads. (e.g., plain cotton) <li>Hard: Weaving patterned medium cloths or simple cloths using varying thickness of threads (e.g., Plaid cotton or mixed plain cloth). <li>Very Hard: Weaving mixed or fine threads into a patterned cloth. (e.g., Silk cloths for plain Kimonos or Sarees) <li>Extremely Hard: Weaving complex mixtures of threads into plain cloths (e.g., gold thread into cotton or silk) <li>Sheer Folly: Weaving complex mixtures of threads into complex patterns (e.g., Gold threaded silk into complex patterned cloths) <li>Absurd: Weaving cloths using magical thread. An alchemist would be required to enchant the thread.
skills.notes: The difficulty of a Weaving manoeuvre depends on the intricacy of the final product. The durability of the garment also modifies the difficulty of the manoeuvre.

skills.name: Weight-lifting
skills.description: This skill provides a bonus to attempts to lift heavy weights or objects. While it is possible to lift these weights without the use of this skill, the techniques conferred by this skill allow greater weights to be lifted, and the likelihood of injury to be lessened. Note that this skill requires a great deal of practice and exercise to develop properly, and will increase the musculature of the individual. The use of this skill requires a round of preparation during which a 90% activity must be performed and the individual's DB is reduced to zero.
skills.difficulties-summary: <li>Routine: 0.25 x max lift <li>Easy: 0.5 x max lift <li>Light: 0.75 x max lift <li>Medium: 1.0 x max lift <li>Hard: 1.1 x max lift <li>Very Hard: 1.25 x max lift <li>Extremely Hard: 1.5 x max lift <li>Sheer Folly: 2.0 x max lift <li>Absurd: 2.5 x max lift
skills.notes: In order to calculate the amount of weight a character can lift from the ground to above his head use the following formula (Treat non-positive St bonuses as one.): Max Lift = (bodywt. / 2) + (temp Strength stat x Strength stat bonus) / 5 Thus, an average human (with a strength of 50 who weighs 200 lbs.) can lift 110 lbs. An exceptional human (with a strength of 90) can lift 190 lbs. An incredible human (with a strength of 100) can lift 300 lbs. With a good Weightlifting manoeuvre, that person would be an Olympic contender. Combined with Power-throwing, this skill allows characters to use any large object as a weapon. Modifiers: [Flat, level surface:+5] [Weight is unevenly distributed:-20] [Easy hand-holds:+10] [Extra prep round:+10]

skills.name: Wood-crafts
skills.description: This skill provides a bonus for fashioning any object out of the required amount of wood, bone or similar material.
skills.difficulties-summary: <li>Routine: making a crude object (e.g., a staff or club) <li>Easy: Making an object that requires a single piece of wood and no real craftsmanship (e.g., a shovel) <li>Light: Fashioning a simple object that requires multiple pieces of wood (e.g., a box or crate) <li>Medium: Building a simple wooden palisade <li>Hard: Making a simple wood carving whose features are more symbolic than realistic (e.g., an artificial arm) <li>Very Hard: building a swelling with multiple rooms <li>Extremely Hard: making a realistic wood carving <li>Sheer Folly: building an architect's masterpiece that includes dramatic curves and careful attention to detail <li>Absurd: making a life-like carving out of enchanted wood.
skills.notes: The difficulty of Wood-crafts depends on the intricacy of the final product. An ornate carving is more difficult than a simple dwelling. Like many Crafts skills, this skill assumes that the craftsman has an adequate supply of tools. Without the necessary implements, there is little a craftsman can do. (Increase all manoeuvres by at least 3 difficulty levels.)

skills.name: Wrestling
skills.description: This is the skill of using one's arms and legs to grapple an opponent and immobilize him. Note that it is not normally intended to be injurious to either partner, although injury may inadvertently result (this skill may, however, be used to immobilize anopponent who does not wish to be held, but it is assumed that injury in not the intent). Attacks are resolved on the Martial Arts Sweeps Attack Table 4.6 ( p. 99) with a maximum result equivalent to that of a Degree 1 attack, and Grappling criticals are used.
skills.difficulties-summary: No difficulties-summary provided
skills.notes: No notes
